general_rules.description: Use casual tone and first names only with internal team members (Arjun, Tom, Léa, Inès); no formal greeting or closing required.
Switch to French with formal 'vous' addressing for external French contacts (investors, clients, government partners); include full signature with title when appropriate.
Use semi-formal English with external English-speaking investors and partners (Marcus, Sarah); greet with 'Hi [Name],' and close with first name only.
Code-switch between French and English within the same email when communicating with bilingual internal team members; maintain casual tone throughout.
Include emoji sparingly in casual internal emails (🚀, 🔥, 👌, 🙏) but never in formal external communications.
Structure technical or data-heavy emails with numbered lists and bullet points for clarity, especially in investor communications.
Keep internal team messages ultra-brief with minimal greeting; jump directly to action items or questions.
Use full legal signature (name + title + company) only for formal French communications with government/banking partners; omit for internal and casual external contacts.
